title: Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is $150 off ahead of Black Friday
content:
Macworld

Apple MacBook Air M5

View Deal

These days we never really know when Apple laptops are going to go on sale. Well, we found a good one today. Ahead of Black Friday, Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is down to $1,149 at Amazon, a savings of $150 off the regular price and the best price we’ve seen since Prime Day when it was just $50 lower.

The M5 MacBook Air is one of the slimmest laptops you can buy right now, but it’s also quite powerful. The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display delivers vivid colors and great contrast so photos pop and videos look rich. The two Thunderbolt 4 ports let you add extra monitors so you can get your tasks done even easier.

Powered by an M5 chip, it delivers a faster CPU and a next-generation GPU, alongside a powerful Neural Engine that keeps your multitasking hours running smoothly. Whether you’re just editing pics, browsing for new book ideas, or juggling a ton of work apps, this laptop can handle it all. Apple Intelligence is built into this laptop, too, helping you write, clean up messages, and whatever else you feel like you need help with. Battery life stretches up to 18 hours, too, so you can’t complain about not being able to use your laptop for the full workday even if you forget your charger at home.

With Black Friday around the corner, you might want to wait for a better deal, but with rising prices and supply shortages, there’s no guarantee it’ll go any lower or have enough stock to deliver in time for the holidays. So if you want one for yourself or some else, go take advantage of this fantastic deal before it’s gone.
